macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks edge higher at the open as investors assess inflation data
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 each rose about 0.3% at the U.S. open, while the Nasdaq gained 0.1%. Nvidia climbed about 2%, while AMD, Broadcom and Cisco declined after recent results.[2]

items.title: October producer prices rise 0.3%, easing from September
items.summary: U.S. producer prices increased 0.3% in October, below expectations cited in market coverage. The data helped support stocks while investors continued assessing inflation risks and the outlook for Federal Reserve policy.[3][8]

items.title: Markets price increased odds of further Fed rate hikes
items.summary: Bank of America expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25 basis points in December, January and March, potentially taking the federal-funds target range to 4.50%-4.75%. Fed officials have also warned that persistent inflation could require additional tightening.[2][9]

items.title: Nvidia rebounds as leadership uncertainty remains in focus
items.summary: Nvidia rose nearly 3% in premarket trading after a sharp selloff linked to reports surrounding CEO Jensen Huang. The AI sector remains a major market focus ahead of Nvidia’s next results presentation.[4]

items.title: Anthropic IPO draws strong investor demand
items.summary: Anthropic’s initial public offering reportedly attracted orders totaling roughly six times the number of shares available, making it a major upcoming test of investor appetite for AI-related offerings.[4]

items.title: Cerebras forecasts stronger quarterly sales
items.summary: Cerebras Systems issued a current-quarter sales forecast above analysts’ estimates, signaling continued demand for AI chips and intensifying competition with Nvidia.[4]

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla reportedly advance merger discussions
items.summary: SpaceX and Tesla are reportedly progressing in merger negotiations, a potentially transformational corporate-development story involving two companies associated with Elon Musk.[4]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Thailand proposes daily stablecoin transaction caps
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC is reportedly considering separate daily limits of $148,000 for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals, alongside a requirement that customers use wallets they own.

items.title: Bitcoin falls roughly 9% for the week
items.summary: Bitcoin was reported near $69,071, down about 9% over the week, reflecting continued market weakness and volatility.

items.title: Coinbase receives approval for national trust company
items.summary: Coinbase announced final approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to charter Coinbase National Trust Company, expanding its regulated financial-services operations.

items.title: Crypto hack losses reach $8.7 billion in 2026
items.summary: ARK research cited losses of $8.7 billion from cryptocurrency hacks so far in 2026, exceeding projected annual on-chain industry revenue.

items.title: Ethereum open interest declines
items.summary: Global Ethereum derivatives open interest reportedly fell 5.24% in 24 hours to $23.851 billion, indicating reduced leveraged exposure.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Anthropic opens private beta for self-hosted Claude Managed Agents
items.summary: Anthropic reportedly opened a private beta for self-hosted managed agents, allowing organizations to run Claude-based agents in their own environments.

items.title: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Small
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab reportedly released Inkling 2 Small, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 594 billion total parameters and about 17 billion active per token.

items.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary: Google reportedly introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an agent-focused model with four reasoning levels and a claimed 2.5-fold speed improvement.

items.title: Kyutai releases open CADRE video autoencoders
items.summary: Kyutai reportedly released CADRE, a family of seven open causal video autoencoders designed for interactive world models and claimed to run at roughly 20 frames per second on one H100 GPU.

items.title: Block announces Dessa speech-to-speech model
items.summary: Block reportedly unveiled Dessa, a speech-to-speech model trained on human conversation that can run locally on high-end MacBook Pro hardware.

items.title: DeepX plans $100 million AI-chip investment
items.summary: South Korean AI-chip startup DeepX reportedly plans to invest more than $100 million in a chip built on Samsung Electronics’ 2-nanometer process, with first samples expected in 2027.

items.title: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini Robotics 2.5
items.summary: Google DeepMind reportedly introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, claiming substantial gains across roughly 200 robotic tasks and a 96% success rate in tests at Mercedes-Benz plants.

items.title: Brookhaven reports unsupervised AI particle-jet separation
items.summary: Brookhaven researchers reportedly developed an AI system that learned to separate particle-jet signals from background in simulated detector data without human-labeled examples.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: The Game Awards to reveal 2026 nominees next week
items.summary: The Game Awards will announce its 2026 nominees during a live special on November 17, two days before the scheduled launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. The event will stream on YouTube and Twitch.

items.title: Microsoft adds 21 original Xbox games to PC backward compatibility
items.summary: Microsoft has expanded its PC backward-compatibility program with 21 additional original Xbox titles, including TimeSplitters 2, The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind, and several Star Wars games.

items.title: Dark Souls 2 and 3 online servers return
items.summary: FromSoftware restored online multiplayer servers for Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3 after an outage lasting nearly two weeks.

items.title: Paradox Interactive CEO Fredrik Wester steps down
items.summary: Fredrik Wester is stepping down as CEO of Paradox Interactive for the second time. The company is known for franchises including Crusader Kings, Stellaris, and Cities: Skylines.

items.title: Wolfenstein 3 confirmed in development
items.summary: MachineGames confirmed that Wolfenstein 3 is actively in production, ending longstanding speculation about the next mainline entry in the shooter series.

items.title: Doom veterans form new studio Hidden Horses
items.summary: Former id Software developers have established Hidden Horses following layoffs at the studio. The new team plans to develop a single-player area shooter called Danger Pay and intends to launch a Kickstarter campaign.

items.title: GDC survey highlights continuing game-industry instability
items.summary: A new GDC industry survey reports that 34% of respondents were laid off during the past two years and 21% are currently unemployed. The report also finds rising generative-AI adoption alongside widespread concern about its impact on games.

items.title: PUBG Mobile Flash launches for mobile devices
items.summary: PUBG Mobile Flash is reported to be launching on Android and iOS on November 13, 2026, with regional availability and download details highlighted in coverage.

items.title: YouTube announces 24-hour Grand Theft Auto VI launch livestream
items.summary: YouTube announced a special 24-hour livestream planned for Grand Theft Auto VI’s November 19 launch, featuring gaming creators and launch-related programming.
